conditions: This is a fix-version claim: the described FormData duck-typing header-injection issue affects the 1.x line before 1.15.1, and is not present starting with this version.
summary: axios >=1.0.0, <1.15.1 (and <=0.31.0 on 0.x) has header injection via prototype pollution (CVE-2026-42035, GHSA-6chq-wfr3-2hj9). lib/adapters/http.js duck-typed FormData via isFormData(data) && isFunction(data.getHeaders); if Object.prototype is polluted with getHeaders/append/pipe/on/once/Symbol.toStringTag, a plain object is misidentified as FormData and the attacker's getHeaders() is merged into outgoing request headers. Fixed in 1.15.1 via an own-property check.
